name: Wide events - sync health
description: Minimal wide-event dashboard (F-OBS-T20): the p95 sync duration definition-of-done query, sync error rate, and a signpost for the infra queue-depth gauge. Import via Dashboards -> Import Dashboard; see docker/observability/hyperdx/README.md.

config.name: p95 sync duration by broker (positions > 100)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    SpanAttributes['broker'] AS broker,
    quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS p95_duration_ms,
    count() AS sampled_syncs
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE SpanAttributes['event.name'] = 'portfolio.sync.completed'
  AND toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['positions_seen']) > 100
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY broker
ORDER BY p95_duration_ms DESC

config.name: Sync error rate (failed / completed, plus HTTP 500)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS hour,
    countIf(SpanAttributes['event.name'] = 'portfolio.sync.failed') AS failed_syncs,
    countIf(SpanAttributes['event.name'] = 'portfolio.sync.completed') AS completed_syncs,
    round(countIf(SpanAttributes['event.name'] = 'portfolio.sync.failed') / nullIf(countIf(SpanAttributes['event.name'] = 'portfolio.sync.completed'), 0), 4) AS failed_per_completed,
    countIf(SpanAttributes['event.name'] = 'http.request' AND SpanAttributes['status'] = '500') AS http_500s
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE SpanAttributes['event.name'] IN ('portfolio.sync.failed', 'portfolio.sync.completed', 'http.request')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour

config.name: Queue depth (infra gauge - not a wide event)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    'queue depth' AS signal,
    'Prometheus gauge queue_depth (worker /metrics, README section 4)' AS source,
    'Huey dashboard /worker/api' AS where_to_look,
    'not a wide event - nothing to query in ClickHouse by design' AS note
